finance_treasury_accounts.definition:
SELECT 'bank'::text AS kind,
    finance_bank_accounts.id AS account_id,
    finance_bank_accounts.id AS bank_account_id,
    NULL::uuid AS cash_location_id,
    finance_bank_accounts.short_name AS name_th,
    finance_bank_accounts.short_name AS name_en,
    finance_bank_accounts.bank_name,
    finance_bank_accounts.account_number,
    finance_bank_accounts.is_active
   FROM finance_bank_accounts
  WHERE treasury_can_view(finance_bank_accounts.id, NULL::uuid)
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'cash'::text AS kind,
    finance_cash_locations.id AS account_id,
    NULL::uuid AS bank_account_id,
    finance_cash_locations.id AS cash_location_id,
    finance_cash_locations.name_th,
    finance_cash_locations.name_en,
    NULL::text AS bank_name,
    NULL::text AS account_number,
    finance_cash_locations.is_active
   FROM finance_cash_locations
  WHERE treasury_can_view(NULL::uuid, finance_cash_locations.id);

finance_treasury_balances.definition:
SELECT a.kind,
    a.account_id,
    a.bank_account_id,
    a.cash_location_id,
    a.name_th,
    a.name_en,
    a.bank_name,
    a.account_number,
    a.is_active,
    b.currency,
    b.opening_id,
    b.opening_as_of,
    b.opening_amount::numeric(14,2) AS opening_amount,
    b.system_balance,
    b.inflow,
    b.outflow
   FROM finance_treasury_accounts a
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL expense_account_balance(a.bank_account_id, a.cash_location_id) b(currency, opening_id, opening_as_of, opening_amount, system_balance, inflow, outflow);

finance_payment_effective_invoice_alloca.definition:
WITH allocation_legs AS (
         SELECT allocation.payment_id,
            allocation.invoice_id,
            allocation.cash_allocated::numeric AS cash_delta,
            allocation.wht_credit_allocated::numeric AS wht_delta
           FROM finance_payment_invoice_allocations allocation
        UNION ALL
         SELECT reallocation.payment_id,
            reallocation.source_invoice_id,
            - reallocation.cash_moved::numeric,
            - reallocation.wht_moved::numeric
           FROM finance_payment_allocation_reallocations reallocation
        UNION ALL
         SELECT reallocation.payment_id,
            reallocation.target_invoice_id,
            reallocation.cash_moved::numeric AS cash_moved,
            reallocation.wht_moved::numeric AS wht_moved
           FROM finance_payment_allocation_reallocations reallocation
        ), effective AS (
         SELECT allocation_legs.payment_id,
            allocation_legs.invoice_id,
            sum(allocation_legs.cash_delta)::numeric(14,2) AS effective_cash_allocated,
            sum(allocation_legs.wht_delta)::numeric(14,2) AS effective_wht_credit_allocated
           FROM allocation_legs
          GROUP BY allocation_legs.payment_id, allocation_legs.invoice_id
        )
 SELECT payment_id,
    invoice_id,
    effective_cash_allocated,
    effective_wht_credit_allocated,
    (effective_cash_allocated + effective_wht_credit_allocated)::numeric(14,2) AS effective_settlement_total
   FROM effective
  WHERE effective_cash_allocated <> 0::numeric OR effective_wht_credit_allocated <> 0::numeric;
